svg.text: I'm a Cloud & DevOps Engineer, AWS Security Architect,
and Full Stack Web Developer, currently completing my
MCA at Karnatak University, Dharwad. I design resilient
downtime CI/CD pipelines, and privacy-first local AI
systems with Ollama and Hugging Face.
My flagship project is AWS CloudShield — an enterprise
controls across 9 regions with ~40-second audits and
Beyond the terminal: story-driven games like RDR2 and
The Last of Us, EA Sports FC and F1 Sim Racing — plus
live Formula 1 Grands Prix and international football.
